task.question: Extract local depth covariance and classify exact saturated anchor-free periodic models.
task.domain: Finite signed Fourier matrices and periodic cell models, not actual zeta zeros.
assumptions: Generalized cell mean rho=sum m/Q is retained; only rho=1 matches the preceding whole-model normalization.
Quantitative covariance uses exact common-coset centers, or the explicitly supplied cell-preserving phase error; a=0 off pair sites.
The lower nonlinear constant requires kappa_A>0; combining with the signed defect uses A<=2*pi. A<=log 2 gives the rational bound.
Exact equality classification uses m in {0,2} and every occupied center in its own supplied cell, without a small-depth condition.
Local block length is fixed before taking sequence limits; no global uniform phase/depth coherence is inferred.

backend_decision.reason: Portable finite Fourier tests and exact Fraction/integer regressions; selected local imports live-checked.
backend_decision.local_readiness: Python/NumPy/mpmath callable; sage and wolframscript absent from PATH.
backend_decision.inventory_boundary: Bundled inventory/record runner not executed; direct local readiness only, not a global MCP availability claim.

precision.mode: Exact Python integers/Fraction; binary64 finite matrices; 80-digit mpmath scalar evaluations.
precision.certification: No interval arithmetic and no formal proof.

execution.development_run: An eight-sample run preceded the added phase-error and equality-short-floor checks. Final full run included both additions and passed. No failed program assertion occurred.

result_summary.float_boundary: Tiny negative slacks are preserved in validation.json and are within declared tolerance.
result_summary.exactness_boundary: Rational/integer tests check recurrences, compositions, symbol bounds, Newton recurrences and scalar comparisons, not universal mathematical truth.

methods: DFT versus csc-square spatial form; signed matrix versus coefficient expansion.
Constructed equality models, exact integer Toeplitz displacement and rational reciprocal-binomial Newton identities.
Local variance, phase-error, shallow-depth and slow-wave regressions.
limitations: No proof of RH or unconditional zero-proportion improvement.
No independent-verifier receipt or formal proof; finite checks do not cover the universal quantifiers.
No actual-zeta cell representation, source weight/localization transfer or arithmetic moment budget.
No full-repository local tests, bundled inventory/record validation, upstream Lean build or isolated verifier.
Random models and constructed equality examples are not exhaustive classification tests.
The high-depth sign guard is numerical and not used as an analytic certificate.
Exact equality does not provide a period-uniform near-equality modulus.
